data.name: InvalidConsumerIdentityTitle
data.value: Invalid consumer identity

data.name: InvalidConsumerIdentityMessage
data.value: The identity '{0}' on consumer class '{1}' must be a compile-time constant in owner.name form: at most 200 characters, a non-empty owner segment and name separated by '.', no empty segments, no surrounding whitespace, and no control characters

data.name: DuplicateConsumerIdentityTitle
data.value: Duplicate consumer identity

data.name: DuplicateConsumerIdentityMessage
data.value: The {0} consumer identity '{1}' is already used by another consumer class in this assembly

data.name: MissingConsumeInterfaceTitle
data.value: Consumer class does not implement IConsume<T>

data.name: MissingConsumeInterfaceMessage
data.value: The consumer class '{0}' must implement at least one IConsume<T>; the messages a consumer handles are the IConsume<T> interfaces it implements

data.name: DuplicateQueueConsumerTitle
data.value: Second Queue consumer for one message

data.name: DuplicateQueueConsumerMessage
data.value: The message '{0}' already has a [QueueConsumer] in this assembly; a Queue message has exactly one consumer

data.name: InvalidFailurePolicyTitle
data.value: Failure policy type cannot be constructed by generated code

data.name: InvalidFailurePolicyMessage
data.value: The failure policy '{0}' of consumer class '{1}' must be a non-abstract class with no open type parameters, derived from Headless.Reliability.FailurePolicy, public or internal like every type that contains it, with a public parameterless constructor

data.name: SubscriptionHookWithoutEveryInstanceTitle
data.value: IOnSubscriptionEstablished on a consumer that is not every-instance

data.name: SubscriptionHookWithoutEveryInstanceMessage
data.value: The consumer class '{0}' implements IOnSubscriptionEstablished, which only runs for a [BusConsumer] with EveryInstance = true; a competing consumer keeps its backlog and never needs it

data.name: InaccessibleConsumerTitle
data.value: Consumer class or message type is inaccessible to generated code

data.name: InaccessibleConsumerMessage
data.value: The type '{0}' used by consumer class '{1}' must be public or internal, like every type that contains it, and must not be file-local

data.name: AbstractOrGenericConsumerTitle
data.value: Abstract or generic consumer class

data.name: AbstractOrGenericConsumerMessage
data.value: The consumer class '{0}' must not be abstract, generic, or nested in a generic type, so the generated dispatcher can construct it

data.name: MultipleLaneAttributesTitle
data.value: Consumer class declares both lane attributes

data.name: MultipleLaneAttributesMessage
data.value: The consumer class '{0}' carries both [BusConsumer] and [QueueConsumer]; a consumer names exactly one lane

data.name: FailurePolicyOnEveryInstanceTitle
data.value: Failure policy on an every-instance consumer

data.name: FailurePolicyOnEveryInstanceMessage
data.value: The consumer class '{0}' declares a FailurePolicy on a [BusConsumer] with EveryInstance = true; every-instance deliveries are at most once and never stored, so no policy can run for them
